# Summit HVAC Supply

> Bay Area HVAC equipment supply from Newark, CA: TCL, TOSOT and Carrier heat pumps,
> ductless mini splits, air handlers, furnaces and installation supplies.
> Equipment supply only. Installation is performed by qualified local contractors.

Summit serves homeowners buying a single system and HVAC contractors, property managers,
and procurement teams who need Bay Area stock, will-call pickup and delivery.

- Location: 5437 Central Ave., Suite 10, Newark, CA 94560
- Phone: (415) 988-4445 (call to confirm today's counter hours)
- Email: InfoSummitHvacSupply@gmail.com
- Service area: San Jose, Oakland, Fremont, San Francisco, the Peninsula, East Bay, South Bay, North Bay, and nearby Bay Area cities.
- Prices: where a retail price is shown it is the public price; approved trade accounts see their own pricing after sign-in. Unpriced items are quoted by the Newark counter.

## Shop and buy

- [Product catalog](https://www.summithvacsupply.com/products): search by SKU, model number or category
- [System finder](https://www.summithvacsupply.com/finder): size and match a heat pump or mini split
- [For homeowners](https://www.summithvacsupply.com/homeowners): buying one system and finding an installer
- [For contractors](https://www.summithvacsupply.com/dealers): trade accounts, will-call and job quotes
- [Request a quote](https://www.summithvacsupply.com/quote)
